answer: Each miner must lock 25 POA for twelve epochs and finish five distinct tasks, each reviewed by three randomly assigned peers who share no funding source. Two matching approvals pass a task; proven collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays public: an orchard of steady tenure proves sustained work, a glacier of slow accumulation resists burst farming, and a grove of independent reviewers shows real verification. Any extra sybil identity still needs its own bond, task record, and reviewers, so mass cloning costs far more than honest effort.
